sections.title: Local SEO, AI Search & Content — three battlegrounds we fight

items.title: Local SEO — own the Google Maps 3-pack
items.body:
When someone searches “beauty salon near me” or “botox clinic Dubai Marina”, Google shows a map with three businesses before anything else. Those three positions take the overwhelming majority of calls and direction taps — everyone else is scenery.

We optimise your Google Business Profile end to end: categories, treatments as services, photo strategy, Q&A seeding, weekly posts and a review engine that keeps fresh, genuine reviews flowing — consistently rated among the strongest local ranking signals in Whitespark’s Local Search Ranking Factors survey. That includes NAP consistency (name, address, phone identical everywhere) and citations across UAE directories and 2GIS, a navigation app many UAE residents use alongside Google Maps. Our guide on why clinics don’t show up in Google Maps walks through the most common fixes.

items.title: AI search — be the name ChatGPT recommends
items.body:
A growing share of your clients skip the ten blue links entirely: they ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google’s AI Overview for “the best medspa in Abu Dhabi” — and trust whatever names come back. If AI engines don’t know your clinic exists, that entire audience books elsewhere.

AI SEO — also called GEO (generative engine optimisation) or AEO (answer engine optimisation) — is about becoming a well-documented entity: consistent facts about your business across the web, question-formatted content AI loves to cite, and the review mass that makes you the statistically safe recommendation.

items.title: Content that books, not just ranks
items.body:
Rankings without bookings are a vanity metric. We write for search intent first — matching what someone actually wants when they type a query — which is also what builds topical authority over time. For clinics with a bilingual client base, that includes Arabic-language pages: a meaningful share of UAE searches happen in Arabic first, and most agencies never touch it. Every piece of content we publish has a commercial job: treatment pages that answer price and safety questions before the client asks, comparison guides that capture “X vs Y” searches, and local guides that own “best in [area]” queries.

It’s published on a schedule, interlinked into your treatment pages, and always ends where it should — at your booking flow, whether that’s an online booking page or an AI booking assistant on WhatsApp.

The approach changes by business type: SEO for aesthetic clinics and medical spas has to stay within DHA and DoH advertising rules, while beauty salons and hair salons usually win on location and service-menu pages.

  • Treatment pages with pricing, FAQs & a clear booking path
  • "Cost of X in Dubai" guides that capture buyers
  • Comparison & "best of" content for high-intent searches
  • Seasonal content — wedding, summer, Ramadan peaks

sections.title: SEO questions owners ask, answered straight

items.title: How long does SEO take for a clinic?
items.text: Local and Maps improvements typically show in 4–8 weeks; competitive treatment keywords take 3–6 months. Unlike ads, every month compounds — rankings earned keep paying without per-click cost.

items.title: SEO or Google Ads — which first?
items.text: They're teammates, not rivals: Google Ads buy immediate bookings while SEO builds the free channel underneath. Clinics that run both convert better too — appearing in ads and organic reinforces trust on the results page. Our guide to Google Ads keywords for clinics shows where paid search fits.

items.title: What are "money keywords" for beauty?
items.text: Terms typed by clients ready to book: treatment + city ("hydrafacial dubai"), "near me" searches, and cost queries ("botox price abu dhabi"). We prioritise these over vanity traffic every time. Have more questions? See our full FAQ.

items.title: Why does my Google Business Profile matter so much?
items.text: For local beauty searches, the Maps 3-pack appears above regular results — and profile signals (reviews, photos, categories, activity) decide who's in it. It's the highest-leverage asset most clinics neglect.

items.title: What is schema markup, in plain words?
items.text: Structured data (also called schema markup) is code that labels your content so Google — and increasingly AI engines — understand it: this is a clinic, these are services, these are prices. It can make your pages eligible for richer search results (Google never guarantees them) and helps search and AI engines pull accurate facts about your business.

items.title: Why a niche SEO agency instead of a generic SEO company?
items.text: Because we're not guessing. As a dedicated beauty SEO agency, we already know which keywords convert in the UAE, what content Google rewards in this industry, and the compliance lines aesthetic clinics can't cross — DHA rules in Dubai, DoH in Abu Dhabi, MOHAP federally — the exact things a generalist SEO company spends your budget learning first. See our full range of services.
